title: A/R Detail: a CSV export that fails shows one error and downloads nothing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the report has open documents on today's date.
  • Make sure you can switch this computer's network connection off and on (such as Wi-Fi).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Switch the computer's network connection off.
  2. Click the ⋯ button.
  3. Click "Download (CSV)".
  4. Switch the network connection back on.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The computer is offline.
  • The report stays on screen.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The error message "We couldn't export this report. Please try again." shows: exactly one message, no second generic error.
  • Nothing is downloaded (no new file in the browser's downloads).

Step 4:

  • The connection is back.
  • A new export works again.

The server-error half of the same sentence cannot be caused by hand; the developers' automated tests cover it. This case covers the lost connection.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • Story 3, Error Handling: “If an export fails for any other reason (a server error or a lost connection), nothing downloads and one error message shows: "We couldn't export this report. Please try again." This message is on these six reports only; the other reports keep theirs.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Export fails for any other reason | "We couldn't export this report. Please try again." | Error toast; nothing downloads; these six reports only”
